# GradeForAI

> AI Agent Optimization (AAO) scoring platform that grades businesses on whether AI agents can physically operate on their website.

GradeForAI measures whether AI agents can navigate a business website, extract accurate operational data, and complete transactions on behalf of users. We scan any business URL and produce a 0-100 AI Agent Preference Score across 4 dimensions: Agent Accessibility, Transaction Completeness, Data Reliability, and Competitive Position. Scores are industry-calibrated across 10+ verticals.

## Services

- Free AAO Scan: Enter any business URL and get a score with grade instantly. No signup required.
- Full AAO Report ($199): Detailed PDF with findings, plain-English recommendations, competitor comparison, industry benchmarks, and 30-day implementation roadmap.
- AAO Implementation ($2,500+): We implement all recommended fixes including Schema.org markup, booking integration, payment setup, llms.txt, and agent-card configuration.

## Data

Hundreds of thousands of service businesses scored across 40+ verticals and 200+ cities. Average score: 27/100. 67% score an F.
